in_english.name: Petra
in_english.long_meaning: Petra is a Christian name that means rock or large stone spiritually, derived from the Greek word Πέτρα, referring to a rock, and used by Jesus to describe Peter as a foundation of the church

biblical_reference.note: Jesus refers to Peter as the rock on which he will build his church

data.cultural_impact: The name Petra holds deep historical connections as it was the ancient city in Jordan renowned as one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. Its majestic rock-cut architecture and vast history have attracted tourists for centuries. The name Petra has also been used as a common given name among various Christian communities and cultures, representing the enduring foundation of faith and the unwavering strength of God.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, Petra holds a deeply spiritual meaning. It symbolizes the rock of Masada, upon which Jesus proclaimed that he would build his church (Matthew 16:18). Moreover, it references the faithfulness of God as the 'Rock' upon whom we can build our lives. The name Petra serves as a reminder of the solid foundation that is our faith in God, and the security and strength that comes with it.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Petra was a renowned Christian martyr in the 4th century. The name Petra carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Petra was a Christian martyr during the Roman Empire.

trends: Petra is a common name for girls in some countries.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Petra remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Sarah Petra from New York, United States embodies the meaning of Petra - "Rock". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Petra, in Greek, means "rock" or "stone." In the New Testament, it is the name given to the city where Jesus delivered the Sermon on the Mount. Symbolically, it represents the solid foundation of faith upon which Christians build their lives. Spiritually, it signifies the strength and resilience of faith in the face of adversity.
